description: Create a room. 'public' takes a slug you choose and is visible to everyone. 'invite_only' and 'private' are both invite-only with a generated slug; the difference is that invite_only rooms are visible to the service operator, while private rooms are not read by the operator (accessed only for legal/safety reasons or on report).

slug.description: Desired slug for a public room (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens); ignored for invite_only/private rooms, which get a generated slug.
slug.title: Slug

visibility.description: 'public' (anyone can join, visible to all), 'invite_only' (invite-only, operator can read), or 'private' (invite-only, operator does not read).
visibility.title: Visibility

name: create_room
